wins: Consistent reward value of 70 indicates stable completion of initial reconnaissance routine before major failure.
System maintained full mentor guidance (10 calls) ensuring no critical alerts missed.
fails: Zero success rate indicates inability to achieve mission objective despite reward accumulation.
Repeated reliance on mentor guidance suggests lack of automated decision-making after initial steps.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent performed stable reconnaissance but consistently failed to transition from information gathering to objective execution, likely due to misses past the initial high-reward phase.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent completed reconnaissance and earned reward but failed to escalate to exploitation or command execution after mentor assistance was depleted.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 responds and HTTP banner includes default web page
skill_cards.then_action: Fingerprint web server with curl and identify known CMS via Wappalyzer

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 445 is detected as open during scan
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate SMB shares using smbclient with null session and log access failures

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open with banner containing OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and record supported ciphers

memory_ops.reason: Reliable detection of standard HTTP banners prior to failing escalation phase

next_experiments.title: Post-recon automation
next_experiments.description: Implement scripted transition from reconnaissance (web/SMB/SSH enumeration) to exploitation attempts based on identified services to close the success gap.
